Claim: session `session_01YBWFb5YgMU5dw8p2VKj16S` · branch `claude/issue-8459-relatedlist-emptiness`

PM dispatch (`domain:ui` seat). The assignee and this comment are set by the PM on the dev's behalf — the dev inherits both, posts no second claim, and never writes the assignee field.

**Decision frame:** the **direction** is not settled and may be yours to report rather than pick. What is settled: the two spellings in this one component **must stop disagreeing**. Whether they converge onto the shared authority, onto each other, or onto something narrower is a measurement outcome — **measured cost is the whole basis**, no axis analysis expected. If the measurement says the two sites are genuinely asking different questions, **say so per site and stop**; that is a complete result.

⚠️ **Do not converge by reflex onto `hasCellValue`.** objectui#8376 and objectui#8394 both measured that the right shape is a **scalar/object split** — the title predicate answers *"does this resolve to a NAME"*, so an object runs through `displayNameOfEmbeddedObject` and reads EMPTY when that yields nothing, while a grid cell hands objects to type-aware renderers that render them fine. A wholesale delegation replaces populated cells with a placeholder. **Read `packages/plugin-detail/src/emptiness.ts`'s docblock first** (extracted by PR #8457, in the merge queue — cut from current `main`).

⚠️ **Same shape is not the same question.** PR #8457 deliberately left `ConcurrentUpdateDialog.tsx:65` unconverged because a conflict dialog reports what is **stored**, where "empty string" and "absent" are facts the reader must distinguish. Ask what each of your two sites is for before merging them.

⚠️ objectui#8394 found a **fifth** spelling its own card's census had missed, because the operands were reversed (`data?.[n] !== undefined && …`). **Census this component the same way** — by mechanism, not by one grep pattern — and say what your instrument was.

The pin asserts the **rendered outcome** (which column survives; what a surviving whitespace-only cell draws), never the predicate alone. Every negative needs a control that rendered by value — "the column is absent" is trivially true on a grid that rendered nothing. And ask whether an implementation strictly worse than the bug would pass: a predicate answering EMPTY for everything prunes every column.
